title: Restore Journey completion analytics in the active Frequency Space overview

source.ref: LIVE-422: legacy dashboard reader existed but active gated overview omitted it

detail: The runtime-graph review found a real wiring gap, not disposable dead analytics. Restore enrolled/finished/still-going/finish-rate metrics in the active Frequency overview behind the existing manage/staff gate. Reuse the owning-Space plan/enrollment scope and unique-person folding; preserve legacy API behavior while adding an availability-aware read so errors or bounded partial populations display unavailable rather than fabricated zero. Stable enrollment pages avoid silently reporting the API row cap as all-time totals; more than 200 plans or reaching the 10000-enrollment-row proof bound remains explicitly unavailable. Rendered fixtures cover measured data, measured zero and unavailable; existing cross-Space/retake contracts remain, with additional page/failure bounds. No new data collection, consent change, migration, public endpoint or production operation. Scripted/rendered proof only; authenticated browser/production acceptance remains separate.
